templates.use: Short note to a recruiter after applying
templates.text: Hi, I just applied for the {role} role at {company}. I would be glad to share more about my background if useful. Thank you!

templates.use: Asking a contact for a referral
templates.text: Hi, I am applying for the {role} role at {company} and would be grateful for a referral or an introduction to the hiring manager.
